title: Test re-issue from same AuthenticatedDio with fresh receipt time
description: Both new DIO replay tests (python/tests/timing/test_time_sync.py ~438, 467) re-verify the SAME AuthenticatedDio object, so a regression keying time-sample dedupe on receipt time instead of the frame-derived counter (time_sync.py:433) would pass (identical received_monotonic). A re-issue with fresh receipt time (OTA retransmission path) is the untested defense-in-depth route; same-frame link replay is already covered at lines ~548-555.
